title: csv-quality-gate: CSV preflight validation that fails fast before pipeline runs
description: csv-quality-gate is a data quality gate that validates CSV inputs (missing required columns, empty files, duplicate rows, empty required cells, and junk contact rows via the outreach profile) and returns pass / warn / fail with matching exit codes, so a broken CSV is caught before a batch or pipeline run wastes time on bad data. Stdlib-only, no third-party runtime dependencies.
